stemMarkdown: Find the remainder when $326 \times 638$ is divided by $19$.
solutionMarkdown: Reduce each factor first: $326 \equiv 3$ and $638 \equiv 11 \pmod{19}$. So the product is $\equiv 3 \times 11 = 33 \equiv 14 \pmod{19}$.
altSolutionMarkdown: Reducing before multiplying keeps the numbers small — the remainder is unaffected.
